facts.text: Mining, construction, agriculture and forestry specific tools are simulation tools, datasets and frameworks built for, or deliberately adapted to, off-road working machines rather than road cars.
facts.quote: These are the few simulation tools, datasets and frameworks that were built for, or deliberately adapted to, off-road working machines rather than road cars.

facts.text: Most simulation tools originated in road environments with lanes, curbs and traffic lights, whereas a quarry has none of these features.
facts.quote: Most simulation tools grew up on roads with lanes, curbs and traffic lights. A quarry has none of these.

facts.text: Machine and terrain physics tools built for mobile machinery include Mevea, AGX Dynamics, Vortex Studio, Project Chrono, EDEM and Fraunhofer Demify.
facts.quote: Machine and terrain physics tools built for mobile machinery: Mevea, AGX Dynamics, Vortex Studio, Project Chrono, EDEM and Fraunhofer Demify.

facts.text: Road-vehicle validation platforms with explicit off-road packages include the MathWorks Offroad Autonomy Library, IPG's off-highway stack, Applied Intuition, Cognata, AVL's off-road engineering and Foretellix.
facts.quote: Road-vehicle validation platforms with explicit off-road packages: the MathWorks Offroad Autonomy Library, IPG's off-highway stack, Applied Intuition, Cognata, AVL's off-road engineering

facts.text: AVL's Generic Off-Road Automation System was demonstrated on a tractor.
facts.quote: AVL's off-road engineering (its Generic Off-Road Automation System demonstrated on a tractor)

facts.text: Foretellix had a partnership for mines and quarries in 2021.
facts.quote: Foretellix (a 2021 partnership for mines and quarries)

facts.text: Off-road-relevant research and military programs include Duality Falcon associated with DARPA RACER-Sim and Fraunhofer ITWM's InVerS construction-site digital twins, RODOS and VMC.
facts.quote: Research and military programs: Duality Falcon (DARPA RACER-Sim), Fraunhofer ITWM (InVerS construction-site digital twins, RODOS, VMC)

facts.text: Fraunhofer IVI provides agricultural and construction machinery testing.
facts.quote: Fraunhofer IVI (agricultural and construction machinery testing)

facts.text: Southwest Research Institute has off-road scene tools for military, space and agriculture applications.
facts.quote: Southwest Research Institute (off-road scene tools for military, space and agriculture)

facts.text: OPAL-RT 4DV-SIM has off-highway and defense users.
facts.quote: OPAL-RT 4DV-SIM (off-highway and defense users)

facts.text: CARLA has only a mining earth-mover asset, rather than the broader off-road capabilities listed for other tools.
facts.quote: CARLA has a mining earth-mover asset only [Chapter 11].

facts.text: MineSim is an open-source, peer-reviewed scenario-based test system and benchmark for autonomous trucks in open-pit mines, dated April 2025.
facts.quote: MineSim, an open-source, peer-reviewed scenario-based test system and benchmark for autonomous trucks in open-pit mines (April 2025)

facts.text: MineSim was built from two real mines and models unstructured roads and heavy-truck response lag.
facts.quote: built from two real mines and modeling unstructured roads and heavy-truck response lag

facts.text: SimMining-3D is a synthetic lidar dataset that varies sensor height because detection degrades when the viewpoint changes on mine benches.
facts.quote: SimMining-3D, a synthetic lidar dataset that varies sensor height because detection degrades when viewpoint changes on mine benches

facts.text: CropCraft, AgriGen and Boreal3D support agricultural and forest scenes.
facts.quote: CropCraft, AgriGen and Boreal3D for agricultural and forest scenes

facts.text: Robotec.ai has a digital twin for Boliden.
facts.quote: a Robotec.ai digital twin for Boliden

facts.text: The Mining3 and ACARP proximity-detection testing framework, project C26028 dated January 2021, is a shared physical test protocol rather than a simulator.
facts.quote: the Mining3 and ACARP proximity-detection testing framework (project C26028, January 2021), a shared physical test protocol rather than a simulator

facts.text: KomVision is Komatsu's human detection and collision mitigation product on excavators, not a simulation tool; the booklet uses KomVision as a market precedent.
facts.quote: KomVision is not a tool: it is Komatsu's human detection and collision mitigation product on excavators, used in the booklet as a market precedent

facts.text: CSIRO was not assessed as a provider, so the booklet records CSIRO's provider status as "not found," not as evidence that CSIRO does not offer relevant tools.
facts.quote: CSIRO was not assessed as a provider, so its status is "not found" rather than "does not offer" [Chapter 11].

facts.text: Independent validation of any of the listed off-road tools, datasets and frameworks for automatic braking on heavy machines was not found.
facts.quote: Independent validation of any of these for automatic braking on heavy machines was not found

facts.text: The booklet treats MineSim as proof that mine-specific closed-loop scenario simulation is feasible, but not as validated sensor physics.
facts.quote: the booklet treats MineSim as proof that mine-specific closed-loop scenario simulation is feasible, "not to be confused with validated sensor physics" [Chapter 1].
